name: Skills and tools
ownerWords:

Skills over 5000 words / SKILL.md files over 500 lines / 이런거좀 보지좀 마 의미없는거

(10-10, c41) another of your duty in Skills and harness is to ensure no rogue plugin/bug is breaking the caching. the cache read ratio of hour/day should stay high.

next to harness health can you put skills are configured correctly

goal: Every skill and tool agents use on this Mac works and is needed. Each tool is installed, signed in and answers a real call, computer use (Cua) and web search first. Each skill passes its smoke check, was read in 14 days and does no other skill's job. The prompt cache read share stays at 90% or more per hour and 94% or more per day; the 10-10 cache bug gave 82 to 89% hours. On 10-19 the precheck took 133 s on us-metal02, over its old 120 s limit, so the limit is 300 s. At 15:30Z Grafana held no prime_agent series, so both cache shares read 100 on no data; p719 fixes the feed and makes no data a miss.

metrics.label: Skills and tools to fix (a failing check an agent can fix, or a skill to prune)
Prompt cache read share, last hour (10-10 cache bug: 82 to 89%)
Prompt cache read share, last day (10-10 cache bug: 90 to 92%)
Fails that only the owner can fix

onMiss: Fix every miss until the run is green; never only report, and never trim a skill for its size. One subagent per tool, skill or cache drop. A failing tool: read its Fix line and change the cause (~/.prime/agent/settings.json, a skill text or link, a CLI or pi-pool sign-in in the owner's Aside browser, the websearch install); re-check with `node --import tsx scripts/duties/skills-and-tools.ts --only <id>`. A skill that fails its smoke check, was not read in 14 days or does another skill's job: fix it, fix the brief that should load it, merge it, or delete it. A cache drop: find the session and plugin behind it, fix the root and add a test. A wrong check gets a fix with a test in sieun-pi. Only a password, 2FA, key or macOS grant goes to the owner, as one For you item. Never send anything outside.
